steps.action: Confirm assigned MLX_STACK_HOME directory starts empty, then run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults`
steps.expected: Missing `~/.mlx-stack/` structure (or missing `stacks/`) is created automatically
steps.observed: From an empty assigned home, init succeeded and generated `/stacks/default.yaml` and `/litellm.yaml`.

steps.action: Run existence checks for stacks dir and generated files

steps.expected: Summary includes generated file paths, tier assignments, total estimated memory, and next-step instructions
steps.observed: Output included Stack/LiteLLM file paths, tier assignment table, `Total estimated memory: 48.3 GB`, and next steps (`mlx-stack pull`, `mlx-stack up`).

assertions.title: Different hardware profiles produce different stacks

steps.action: Set profile to 64 GB in isolated `profile.json`, run `init --accept-defaults --force`
steps.expected: 64 GB stack total estimated memory should be ≤ 25.6 GB
steps.observed: Output reported `Budget: 25.6 GB` but `Total estimated memory: 26.3 GB` (exceeds requirement).

steps.action: Set profile to 128 GB, run `init --accept-defaults --intent balanced --force`, compare models vs 64 GB stack
steps.expected: 128 GB stack includes at least one model excluded from 64 GB stack
steps.observed: Condition met: 128 GB included `qwen3.5-72b`, while 64 GB used `deepseek-r1-32b` instead.

steps.action: On 128 GB profile, compare `init --intent balanced` vs `init --intent agent-fleet`
steps.expected: Selections should differ measurably between intents
steps.observed: Selections were identical for both intents (`qwen3.5-72b`, `qwen3.5-0.8b`, `deepseek-r1-8b`).

assertions.issues: Fails contract criteria: 64 GB stack exceeded 25.6 GB budget target in output summary, and balanced vs agent-fleet selections did not diverge on 128 GB profile.

frictions.description: Physical host is 128 GB only; validating 64 GB branch required manual profile override in isolated `MLX_STACK_HOME/profile.json` before rerunning `init`.
frictions.resolution: Used isolated profile fixtures (`profile-64.json`, `profile-128.json`) and repeated init runs with `--force` to compare outputs deterministically.

summary: Tested 4 assigned assertions via CLI: 3 passed (VAL-INIT-011/012/013) and 1 failed (VAL-CROSS-005) due to 64 GB budget overrun in output summary and no intent-based model selection difference on 128 GB.
